title: Lesson 27. Keyboard controls
description: Your hero from lesson 16 and arrow-key controls: x and y

questions.prompt: Match the command with where the hero goes
Which command goes with the left arrow?
In games the player usually controls the hero.

questions.text: x is right-___, y is up-___.
questions.explain: The two axes of the screen.

questions.prompt: Put in order how to upload your hero
questions.explain: The hero from lesson 16 comes alive.

questions.prompt: The hero is too big on stage. What now?
questions.explain: The Size box under the stage.

questions.prompt: Minus y moves the hero up.
Where do you pick the game background?
options: "Choose a backdrop" at the bottom right

learn.intro: In games the player controls the hero! Today your hero comes alive and obeys the arrow keys.

slides.text: Event blocks **"when key pressed"** — like "when the bell rings — we go on break".

check.prompt: What is the "when key pressed" block like?
options: When the bell rings — break time

slides.text: Under the stage: "Choose a sprite" → **"Upload sprite"** → your Pictures folder → "My hero". Remember the hero you drew? It comes alive in the game!
Drawing too big? Set the sprite size smaller, e.g. **30**. Background — "Choose a backdrop" (forest, space, city).

check.prompt: You can upload your Paint hero into Scratch as a sprite.

slides.text: **x** is right-left, **y** is up-down. Plus means right or up, minus means left or down.
slides.code:
when right arrow key pressed
change x by 10

when left arrow key pressed
change x by -10

check.explain: y is up-down; plus is up.
